blocks.zh: 附錄 1：培養基與安慰劑考量 + 附錄 2：無菌製程模擬執行順序
blocks.en: Appendix 1: Media and Placebo Considerations + Appendix 2: Aseptic Process Simulation Performance Sequence

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 APS 中培養基 (Media) 與安慰劑 (Placebo) 的選擇、滅菌及生長促進測試原則
blocks.en: Understand the principles for selecting, sterilizing and growth-promotion testing media and placebos used in APS

blocks.zh: 掌握 Soybean-Casein Digest Medium (SCDM/TSB) 的特性及不同滅菌方式對其生長促進能力的影響
blocks.en: Understand the characteristics of Soybean-Casein Digest Medium (SCDM/TSB) and how different sterilization methods affect its growth-promotion capability

blocks.zh: 理解培養基的製備、過濾與保存管控要點，包含防止黴漿菌 (Mycoplasma) 污染的策略
blocks.en: Understand the key controls for media preparation, filtration and storage, including strategies to prevent Mycoplasma contamination

blocks.zh: 熟悉 APS 執行的完整前置作業檢查清單 (Performance Sequence Checklist)，確保在模擬前已完成所有必要的確效與資格驗證
blocks.en: Become familiar with the complete pre-execution checklist for an APS (Performance Sequence Checklist), so that all necessary validation and qualification work is finished before the simulation

blocks.zh: 學會運用系統性方法規劃 APS 範圍、執行模擬、培養檢查及文件記錄的全流程
blocks.en: Learn to apply a systematic approach to the whole APS workflow: defining scope, executing the simulation, incubation and inspection, and documentation

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Section Contents
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 13.0 Appendix 1: Media and Placebo Considerations 13.0 附錄一：培養基與安慰劑考量事項
blocks.en: 13.0 Appendix 1: Media and Placebo Considerations

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Placebo / Surrogate Material (安慰劑/替代物): 在 APS 中，並非所有劑型都能直接使用液態培養基來模擬。懸浮劑、軟膏、乳膏和乾粉充填等劑型，需要使用與產品物理特性相似的安慰劑或替代物，搭配生長促進培養基一起使用。
blocks.en: Placebo / Surrogate Material: In an APS, not every dosage form can be simulated directly with liquid media. Suspensions, ointments, creams and dry powder fills need a placebo or surrogate material with physical properties similar to the product, used together with a growth-promoting medium.

blocks.zh: 常見的替代物包括：乾粉、增稠劑、緩衝液、注射用水 (WFI) 等。關鍵原則是：替代物必須模擬產品的物理特性，但不能增加或減少無菌製程的風險。
blocks.en: Common surrogates include dry powders, thickening agents, buffers and water for injection (WFI). The key principle is that the surrogate must mimic the physical properties of the product without increasing or decreasing the risk of the aseptic process.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一場消防演習 -- 你不能用真火來測試疏散流程，但也不能完全省略煙霧和警報。安慰劑就像演習中的人造煙霧：它必須讓流程「感覺起來」像真正的緊急狀況（模擬產品的流動性、黏度等），但又不能真的帶來危險。如果用的煙霧太少，演習就無法真實反映挑戰；如果用了不適當的材料，反而會引入真正的風險。
blocks.en: Think of a fire drill. You cannot use a real fire to test the evacuation procedure, but you cannot leave out the smoke and alarms entirely either. A placebo is like the artificial smoke in the drill: it has to make the procedure "feel" like a real emergency (simulating the flow, viscosity and so on of the product) without creating real danger. If too little smoke is used, the drill does not reflect the real challenge; if an unsuitable material is used, it introduces a real risk.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 文件記錄義務：使用替代物時，必須記錄其適用性的理由 (justification)。此外，如果安慰劑的包裝和處理方式與實際產品不同，必須評估這些差異對製程的潛在影響，以及是否需要額外的清潔驗證 (cleaning validation)。
blocks.en: Documentation obligation: When a surrogate is used, the justification for its suitability must be documented. In addition, if the packaging and handling of the placebo differ from the actual product, the potential impact of these differences on the process must be assessed, along with whether additional cleaning validation is needed.

blocks.zh: 這在法規查廠時是高頻被查驗的項目 -- 查核員會想了解「你為什麼選這個替代物？它真的能代表你的產品嗎？」
blocks.en: This is one of the items most frequently examined during regulatory inspections. Inspectors will want to know: "Why did you choose this surrogate? Does it really represent your product?"

blocks.zh: 13.1 Selection of Placebo or Surrogate Material 13.1 安慰劑或替代物料的選擇
blocks.en: 13.1 Selection of Placebo or Surrogate Material

blocks.zh: 安慰劑選擇的三大要求：
blocks.en: Three main requirements for placebo selection:

blocks.zh: 無菌 (Sterile)：替代物本身必須是無菌的，否則會引入額外的微生物污染，干擾 APS 結果判讀
blocks.en: Sterile: The surrogate itself must be sterile; otherwise it introduces additional microbial contamination and interferes with the interpretation of APS results

blocks.zh: 物理相似性：必須盡可能模擬產品的流動性、黏度、粒度等特性
blocks.en: Physical similarity: It must mimic the product's flowability, viscosity, particle size and other characteristics as closely as possible

blocks.zh: 支持微生物生長：替代物不能抑制微生物生長，否則即使有污染也無法被偵測到
blocks.en: Supports microbial growth: The surrogate must not inhibit microbial growth; otherwise contamination could go undetected

blocks.zh: 常用安慰劑材料清單：
blocks.en: Commonly used placebo materials:

blocks.zh: Lactose (乳糖)：常用於乾粉充填模擬
blocks.en: Lactose: Commonly used to simulate dry powder filling

blocks.zh: Mannitol (甘露醇)：良好的流動性，適合粉末模擬
blocks.en: Mannitol: Good flowability, suitable for powder simulation

blocks.zh: PEG 6000 (聚乙二醇)：可模擬半固體劑型
blocks.en: PEG 6000 (polyethylene glycol): Can simulate semi-solid dosage forms

blocks.zh: NaCl (氯化鈉)：容易取得、易溶解
blocks.en: NaCl (sodium chloride): Readily available and easily dissolved

blocks.zh: 但要注意：乾燥的無菌培養基粉末因為流動性差，已被證實不適合用於懸浮劑、軟膏、乳膏和乾粉充填操作的 APS。
blocks.en: Note, however, that dry sterile medium powder has been shown to be unsuitable for APS of suspensions, ointments, creams and dry powder filling operations because of its poor flowability.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的工廠生產一種高黏度的眼藥膏，要進行 APS 時，你會選擇什麼安慰劑？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your facility manufactures a high-viscosity eye ointment. Which placebo would you choose for the APS, and why?

blocks.zh: 如果選用的安慰劑在高濃度時會抑制微生物生長，你應該如何處理？
blocks.en: If the selected placebo inhibits microbial growth at high concentrations, how should you handle it?

blocks.zh: 13.2 Sterilization of Placebo or Surrogate Material 13.2 安慰劑或替代物料的滅菌
blocks.en: 13.2 Sterilization of Placebo or Surrogate Material

blocks.zh: 替代物滅菌方法：常見的滅菌方法包括輻射滅菌 (irradiation)、氣體滅菌 (gas, 如 EtO)、乾熱滅菌 (dry heat) 和過濾除菌 (filtration)。選擇滅菌方法時要確認兩件事：
blocks.en: Surrogate sterilization methods: Common methods include irradiation, gas (such as EtO), dry heat and filtration. When choosing a method, confirm two things:

blocks.zh: 滅菌過程不能顯著影響培養基的生長促進能力
blocks.en: The sterilization process must not significantly affect the growth-promotion capability of the medium

blocks.zh: 滅菌過程不能改變替代物的物理特性
blocks.en: The sterilization process must not alter the physical properties of the surrogate

blocks.zh: 就像清洗演員的戲服 -- 洗完之後，戲服必須看起來和穿起來都跟洗之前一樣（物理特性不變），同時上面的細菌也必須被清除（達到無菌）。如果用太強烈的清洗方式把布料洗壞了，那演員就無法穿著它完成排練了。
blocks.en: It is like washing an actor's costume: after washing, it must look and feel the same as before (physical properties unchanged), and the bacteria on it must also be removed (sterility achieved). If the cleaning is so harsh that it ruins the fabric, the actor can no longer wear it for the rehearsal.

blocks.zh: 負對照 (Negative Control)：可以額外準備一批安慰劑放在獨立容器中，作為負對照組進行無菌測試。這有助於確認替代物本身確實是無菌的，排除因替代物帶菌而造成假陽性的風險。
blocks.en: Negative control: An additional batch of placebo can be prepared in a separate container and sterility tested as a negative control. This helps confirm that the surrogate itself is sterile and rules out the risk of false positives caused by a contaminated surrogate.

blocks.zh: 13.3 Growth-Promotion Testing of the Placebo or Surrogate Material 13.3 安慰劑或替代物料的促生長測試
blocks.en: 13.3 Growth-Promotion Testing of the Placebo or Surrogate Material

blocks.zh: Growth-Promotion Testing (生長促進測試)：驗證安慰劑與培養基的組合是否能支持微生物生長的測試。必須使用藥典方法 (pharmacopeial methods) 進行。
blocks.en: Growth-Promotion Testing: A test that verifies whether the combination of placebo and medium supports microbial growth. It must be performed using pharmacopeial methods.

blocks.zh: In-house Isolates (廠內分離株)：除了使用標準菌株外，建議加入從環境監測 (EM)、人員監測和無菌測試失敗案例中回收的廠內菌株，因為這些才是你的工廠真正可能面對的微生物。
blocks.en: In-house isolates: In addition to standard strains, it is recommended to include in-house isolates recovered from environmental monitoring (EM), personnel monitoring and sterility test failures, because these are the organisms your facility is actually likely to face.

blocks.zh: 濃度變化須注意：如果培養基在製備過程中會被稀釋（例如初始使用雙倍濃度，後續稀釋到工作濃度），那麼初始的高濃度也必須進行生長促進測試。這是因為高濃度培養基可能對某些微生物產生抑制效果。
blocks.en: Note concentration changes: If the medium is diluted during preparation (for example, it starts at double strength and is later diluted to working concentration), the initial high concentration must also undergo growth-promotion testing. This is because a high-concentration medium may inhibit some microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 13.4 Solubility Testing of the Placebo or Surrogate Material 13.4 安慰劑或替代物料的溶解度測試
blocks.en: 13.4 Solubility Testing of the Placebo or Surrogate Material

blocks.zh: Solubility Testing (溶解度測試)：確認安慰劑在培養基中的溶解或分散能力。需要記錄攪拌量、溶解時間和溶解程度。如果無法完全溶解或分散，可以降低濃度重新測試，或更換安慰劑材料。
blocks.en: Solubility Testing: Confirms the ability of the placebo to dissolve or disperse in the medium. The amount of agitation, the dissolution time and the extent of dissolution should be recorded. If the placebo cannot dissolve or disperse completely, the test can be repeated at a lower concentration, or a different placebo material can be used.

blocks.zh: 就像做料理前先測試食材的相容性 -- 如果某種調味料無法溶解在湯底中、會沉澱結塊，那你就需要減少用量或換一種調味料。培養基的溶解度測試道理相同：如果安慰劑無法均勻分散在培養基中，微生物可能無法與培養基充分接觸，導致生長受到物理性阻礙。
blocks.en: It is like testing the compatibility of ingredients before cooking: if a seasoning will not dissolve in the broth and settles or clumps, you need to use less of it or switch to another one. Solubility testing of media works the same way: if the placebo cannot disperse evenly in the medium, microorganisms may not come into sufficient contact with the medium, and growth may be physically impeded.

blocks.zh: 13.5 Media Preparation and Sterilization 13.5 培養基的製備與滅菌
blocks.en: 13.5 Media Preparation and Sterilization

blocks.zh: SCDM / TSB (大豆酪蛋白消化培養基)：APS 中最常用的廣譜培養基，能回收細菌和真菌，包括芽孢桿菌、革蘭氏陰性菌和黴菌。近年來，植物性培養基 (Plant-based Media) 越來越受歡迎，原因有二：
blocks.en: SCDM / TSB (Soybean-Casein Digest Medium): The most commonly used broad-spectrum medium in APS, capable of recovering bacteria and fungi, including spore formers, gram-negative bacteria and molds. In recent years, plant-based media have become increasingly popular for two reasons:

blocks.zh: 生長促進能力幾乎相同
blocks.en: Their growth-promotion capability is nearly identical

blocks.zh: 確保無 BSE/TSE（牛海綿狀腦病/傳播性海綿狀腦病）風險
blocks.en: They remove any BSE/TSE (bovine spongiform encephalopathy/transmissible spongiform encephalopathy) risk

blocks.zh: 不會成為黴漿菌 (Mycoplasma) 的潛在來源
blocks.en: They are not a potential source of Mycoplasma

blocks.zh: 滅菌方法對培養基的影響 -- 核心要點：
blocks.en: Effect of sterilization method on media: key points

blocks.zh: 濕熱滅菌 (Moist Heat)：最可靠，但 F0 值應控制在 15-20 分鐘。過度滅菌會引發 Maillard Reaction (梅納反應)，導致培養基焦糖化，降低生長促進能力
blocks.en: Moist heat: The most reliable method, but the F0 value should be controlled at 15-20 minutes. Over-sterilization triggers the Maillard reaction, which caramelizes the medium and reduces its growth-promotion capability

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌 (Radiation)：適合粉末培養基，可有效消除黴漿菌
blocks.en: Radiation: Suitable for powdered media and effective at eliminating Mycoplasma

blocks.zh: 過濾除菌 (Filtration)：標準 0.2μm 過濾可能無法攔截黴漿菌，若有黴漿菌風險需考慮 0.1μm 過濾
blocks.en: Filtration: A standard 0.2μm filter may not retain Mycoplasma; where there is a Mycoplasma risk, consider 0.1μm filtration

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh: F0 值 (殺菌致死力參數)：
blocks.en: F0 value (lethality parameter):

blocks.zh:
F0 = 量化滅菌過程致死力的參數
建議範圍：15-20 分鐘（對培養基而言）
過高 F0 → Maillard Reaction → 焦糖化 → 生長抑制
blocks.en:
F0 = parameter quantifying the lethality of a sterilization process
Recommended range: 15-20 minutes (for media)
Excessive F0 → Maillard reaction → caramelization → growth inhibition

blocks.zh: 這與產品滅菌通常追求更高 F<sub>0</sub> 值的邏輯不同！培養基需要在「足夠殺菌」和「保留生長促進能力」之間取得平衡。
blocks.en: This differs from the logic for product sterilization, which usually aims for a higher F<sub>0</sub> value! Media sterilization needs to balance "sufficient kill" against "retaining growth-promotion capability."

blocks.zh: 培養基的滅菌就像烤麵包 -- 你需要足夠的溫度和時間來殺死酵母（達到無菌），但如果烤太久、溫度太高，麵包就會燒焦（Maillard Reaction），變得又硬又黑，失去食用價值。F<sub>0</sub> 值就像烤箱的時間-溫度設定，15-20 分鐘恰到好處。
blocks.en: Sterilizing media is like baking bread: you need enough temperature and time to kill the yeast (achieve sterility), but if you bake too long or too hot, the bread burns (Maillard reaction) and becomes hard and black, losing its value as food. The F<sub>0</sub> value is like the time-temperature setting on the oven, and 15-20 minutes is just right.

blocks.zh: 培養基配製與保存的時間管控：
blocks.en: Time controls for media preparation and storage:

blocks.zh: 配製後到過濾進無菌容器的時間應盡量縮短 -- 因為培養基一旦配製完成，會立即支持任何存在微生物的生長
blocks.en: The time from preparation to filtration into a sterile container should be as short as possible, because once prepared, the medium immediately supports the growth of any microorganisms present

blocks.zh: 建議使用 >60°C 的熱水配製，減少微生物負荷 (bioburden) 並提高溶解度
blocks.en: It is recommended to prepare the medium with hot water at >60°C to reduce bioburden and improve solubility

blocks.zh: 考慮使用預過濾器 (prefilter) 去除未溶解的顆粒，防止堵塞 0.2μm 終端過濾器
blocks.en: Consider using a prefilter to remove undissolved particles and prevent clogging of the 0.2μm final filter

blocks.zh: 優先將培養基過濾至無菌儲罐中待用，而非長時間保存非無菌培養基
blocks.en: Preferably filter the medium into a sterile holding tank for later use, rather than storing non-sterile medium for long periods

blocks.zh: 使用前培養基溫度必須降至 <35°C
blocks.en: The medium temperature must be reduced to <35°C before use

blocks.zh: 黴漿菌 (Mycoplasma) 控制策略：這是 APS 培養基管理中常被忽略的風險。可考慮組合式滅菌策略：
blocks.en: Mycoplasma control strategy: This is a frequently overlooked risk in APS media management. A combined sterilization strategy can be considered:

blocks.zh: 購買已輻射滅菌的粉末培養基（確保無黴漿菌）
blocks.en: Purchase pre-irradiated powdered medium (ensuring it is free of Mycoplasma)

blocks.zh: 用 WFI 溶解產生極低生物負荷的溶液
blocks.en: Dissolve it in WFI to produce a solution with very low bioburden

blocks.zh: 最後進行無菌過濾
blocks.en: Finish with sterile filtration

blocks.zh: 這種組合方式在 ATMP (先進療法醫藥產品) 製造領域尤其重要，因為黴漿菌污染是細胞治療產品的重大風險。
blocks.en: This combined approach is especially important in ATMP (advanced therapy medicinal product) manufacturing, because Mycoplasma contamination is a major risk for cell therapy products.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 商業規模情境：當你的 CDMO 需要支援商業規模充填時，高壓蒸氣釜可能無法產出足夠的培養基量。此時需要在適當的容器中進行 SIP（就地滅菌），但必須注意控制 F0 值不要超過 20 分鐘。建議在 SIP 前確認培養基供應商的建議滅菌時間和溫度。
blocks.en: CDMO commercial-scale scenario: When your CDMO needs to support commercial-scale filling, an autoclave may not be able to produce a sufficient volume of medium. In that case, SIP (sterilization in place) in a suitable vessel is needed, but you must make sure the F0 value does not exceed 20 minutes. Before SIP, confirm the medium supplier's recommended sterilization time and temperature.

blocks.zh: 為什麼植物性培養基在近年來越來越受歡迎？與傳統 SCDM 相比有哪些優勢？
blocks.en: Why have plant-based media become increasingly popular in recent years? What advantages do they have over traditional SCDM?

blocks.zh: 如果你發現培養基在過濾時頻繁堵塞濾芯，可能的原因和解決方案是什麼？
blocks.en: If you find that the filter cartridge clogs frequently during media filtration, what are the possible causes and solutions?

blocks.zh: 在 ATMP 製造中，為什麼黴漿菌控制對培養基選擇特別重要？
blocks.en: In ATMP manufacturing, why is Mycoplasma control especially important in media selection?

blocks.zh: 14.0 Appendix 2: Aseptic Process Simulation Performance Sequence 14.0 附錄二：無菌製程模擬執行順序
blocks.en: 14.0 Appendix 2: Aseptic Process Simulation Performance Sequence

blocks.zh: APS Performance Sequence (APS 執行順序)：這份檢查清單是 PDA TR22 提供的最實用工具之一。它將整個 APS 流程分為五大階段：
blocks.en: APS Performance Sequence: This checklist is one of the most practical tools provided by PDA TR22. It divides the whole APS process into five phases:

blocks.zh: 前置確認 (Pre-Initiation)：確認所有確效、資格驗證和支持系統已就緒
blocks.en: Pre-Initiation: Confirm that all validation, qualification and supporting systems are in place

blocks.zh: 範圍定義 (Scope Definition)：明確 APS 涵蓋的製程條件和變數
blocks.en: Scope Definition: Define clearly the process conditions and variables the APS covers

blocks.zh: 計畫開發 (Plan Development)：編寫方案和批次紀錄
blocks.en: Plan Development: Write the protocol and batch record

blocks.zh: 模擬執行 (Execution)：實際執行 APS 並進行培養/檢查
blocks.en: Execution: Actually perform the APS, then incubate and inspect

blocks.zh: 文件記錄 (Documentation)：完成報告和人員資格記錄
blocks.en: Documentation: Complete the report and personnel qualification records

blocks.zh: 這份檢查清單就像飛行員的起飛前檢查表 (pre-flight checklist)。即使是最有經驗的飛行員，每次起飛前都必須逐項確認：引擎、燃油、儀表、通訊、天氣......。APS 的執行也是同樣的道理 -- 在你「起飛」（開始充填培養基）之前，必須確認所有支持系統都已通過驗證並正常運作。跳過任何一項檢查，都可能導致 APS 結果無效或產生誤判。
blocks.en: This checklist is like a pilot's pre-flight checklist. Even the most experienced pilot must check item by item before every takeoff: engines, fuel, instruments, communications, weather, and so on. The same applies to an APS: before you "take off" (start filling media), you must confirm that all supporting systems have been validated and are working properly. Skipping any check could invalidate the APS results or lead to a misinterpretation.

blocks.zh: 第一階段（前置確認）的關鍵：這是最容易被忽略卻最重要的階段。清單列出了 18 項必須在 APS 開始前確認完成的項目，涵蓋：
blocks.en: Key points of Phase 1 (Pre-Initiation): This is the phase most easily overlooked and yet the most important. The checklist lists 18 items that must be confirmed complete before the APS starts, covering:

blocks.zh: 滅菌製程驗證 (Sterilization Process Validation)
blocks.en: Sterilization process validation (Sterilization Process Validation)

blocks.zh: 人員訓練與無菌衣著資格 (Personnel Training & Gowning Certification)
blocks.en: Personnel training and aseptic gowning qualification (Personnel Training & Gowning Certification)

blocks.zh: 消毒劑確效 (Disinfectant Qualification)
blocks.en: Disinfectant qualification (Disinfectant Qualification)

blocks.zh: 環境監測計畫 (EM Program)
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring program (EM Program)

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性 (Container-Closure Integrity)
blocks.en: Container-closure integrity (Container-Closure Integrity)

blocks.zh: 氣流可視化研究 (Airflow Visualization Studies)
blocks.en: Airflow visualization studies (Airflow Visualization Studies)

blocks.zh: 過濾器完整性 (Filter Integrity)
blocks.en: Filter integrity (Filter Integrity)

blocks.zh: 每一項都對應了具體的 PDA 技術文件，方便查閱更詳細的指引。
blocks.en: Each item corresponds to a specific PDA technical document, making it easy to look up more detailed guidance.

blocks.zh: 第二階段（範圍定義）的關鍵考量：
blocks.en: Key considerations in Phase 2 (Scope Definition):

blocks.zh: 操作人員最大容納量：必須模擬最大房間佔用人數或最大同時使用的隔離器手套數
blocks.en: Maximum operator capacity: The simulation must reflect the maximum room occupancy or the maximum number of isolator gloves in simultaneous use

blocks.zh: 介入操作 (Interventions)：需涵蓋固有介入 (inherent) 和糾正介入 (corrective)，包括其頻率
blocks.en: Interventions: Must cover both inherent and corrective interventions, including their frequency

blocks.zh: 壓力條件：在常規無菌製程上施加合理的壓力條件
blocks.en: Stress conditions: Reasonable stress conditions should be applied to the routine aseptic process

blocks.zh: 環境條件：氣流、溫濕度、壓差等
blocks.en: Environmental conditions: Airflow, temperature and humidity, differential pressure, etc.

blocks.zh: 第四階段（執行）的核心規則：
blocks.en: Core rules of Phase 4 (Execution):

blocks.zh: 充填量：必須足以潤濕所有內部容器表面，但要保留足夠頂空 (headspace) 讓好氧微生物生長
blocks.en: Fill volume: Must be sufficient to wet all internal container surfaces, while leaving enough headspace for aerobic microorganisms to grow

blocks.zh: 介入相關小瓶：可以剔除（或分開培養），但僅限於常規生產中也採取同樣做法的情況。剔除的數量也不能超過常規生產的剔除量
blocks.en: Intervention-related vials: May be rejected (or incubated separately), but only if the same practice is followed in routine production. The number rejected must also not exceed the number rejected in routine production

blocks.zh: 培養條件：使用雙溫培養時，每個溫度至少 7 天，從較低溫開始
blocks.en: Incubation conditions: When two-temperature incubation is used, each temperature must be held for at least 7 days, starting with the lower temperature

blocks.zh: 陽性單位：必須鑑定到種 (species level)，並調查根本原因
blocks.en: Positive units: Must be identified to species level, and the root cause investigated

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務建議：建議將這份 Table 14.0-1🔍 轉化為你工廠專用的 APS 執行 SOP 附件。具體做法：
blocks.en: CDMO practical recommendation: Convert this Table 14.0-1🔍 into an attachment to your facility's own APS execution SOP. Specifically:

blocks.zh: 將每個 Activity 對應到你的內部文件編號
blocks.en: Map each Activity to your internal document numbers

blocks.zh: 在「Additional Information」欄加入你的內部程序參考
blocks.en: Add your internal procedure references in the "Additional Information" column

blocks.zh: 在「Completed」欄加入實際簽核欄位和日期
blocks.en: Add actual sign-off fields and dates in the "Completed" column

blocks.zh: 對於客戶審計，這份完整的檢查清單能展示你的 APS 管理是系統性的、有章可循的
blocks.en: For customer audits, this complete checklist demonstrates that your APS management is systematic and well structured

blocks.zh: 第五階段（文件記錄）-- 法規查廠關注點：
blocks.en: Phase 5 (Documentation): regulatory inspection focus

blocks.zh: APS 結果、評估和結論必須由品質單位 (Quality Unit) 核准的報告記錄
blocks.en: APS results, evaluation and conclusions must be recorded in a report approved by the Quality Unit

blocks.zh: 必須記錄所有參與 APS 的操作人員及其資格有效期
blocks.en: All operators who took part in the APS and the validity period of their qualification must be recorded

blocks.zh: 必須記錄所有已成功展示的介入操作，必要時更新相關程序
blocks.en: All interventions successfully demonstrated must be recorded, and the relevant procedures updated if necessary

blocks.zh: 這些文件是 EU Annex 1 和 FDA 查廠時的重點審查對象。缺少任何一項都可能被開立觀察報告。
blocks.en: These documents are key review targets in EU Annex 1 and FDA inspections. Missing any one of them can result in an observation.

blocks.zh: 為什麼在 APS 開始之前，必須先確認氣流可視化研究 (Airflow Visualization Studies) 已完成？如果跳過這一步可能導致什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why must you confirm that the airflow visualization studies are complete before starting an APS? What problems could result from skipping this step?

blocks.zh: Table 14.0-1🔍 中提到「如果商業製程批次紀錄是電子的，APS 批次紀錄也應該是電子的」，這背後的邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Table 14.0-1🔍 states that "if the commercial process batch record is electronic, the APS batch record should also be electronic." What is the logic behind this?

blocks.zh: APS 執行中，為什麼培養前必須將容器翻轉和旋轉 (invert and swirl)？如果沒做這一步，可能會漏掉什麼？
blocks.en: During APS execution, why must containers be inverted and swirled before incubation? What might be missed if this step is not done?

blocks.zh: 假設你是 CDMO 的 QA 主管，收到一份 APS 報告，發現有一個陽性單位被歸類為「容器密封缺陷」而排除，但報告中沒有詳細說明檢查方法。你會有什麼顧慮？
blocks.en: Suppose you are the QA head at a CDMO and receive an APS report in which a positive unit was classified as a "container closure defect" and excluded, but the report does not describe the inspection method in detail. What concerns would you have?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 培養基與安慰劑選擇 (13.0-13.4)：安慰劑必須無菌、物理特性相似、不抑制微生物生長。常用材料包括乳糖、甘露醇、PEG 6000 和氯化鈉。必須進行溶解度測試和生長促進測試。
blocks.en: Media and placebo selection (13.0-13.4): The placebo must be sterile, physically similar to the product and non-inhibitory to microbial growth. Common materials include lactose, mannitol, PEG 6000 and sodium chloride. Solubility testing and growth-promotion testing must be performed.

blocks.zh: 培養基配製與滅菌 (13.5)：SCDM/TSB 是最常用的廣譜培養基。滅菌時 F0 值控制在 15-20 分鐘，避免 Maillard Reaction。植物性培養基日趨流行（無 BSE/TSE 及黴漿菌風險）。過濾除菌時注意黴漿菌可能穿透 0.2μm 濾膜。
blocks.en: Media preparation and sterilization (13.5): SCDM/TSB is the most commonly used broad-spectrum medium. During sterilization, keep the F0 value at 15-20 minutes to avoid the Maillard reaction. Plant-based media are increasingly popular (no BSE/TSE or Mycoplasma risk). With filter sterilization, note that Mycoplasma may pass through a 0.2μm membrane.

blocks.zh: 培養基保存：配製至過濾的保持時間應最小化，使用 >60°C 熱水配製可降低生物負荷，使用前需冷卻至 <35°C。
blocks.en: Media storage: Minimize the hold time from preparation to filtration; preparing with water at >60°C reduces bioburden; cool the medium to <35°C before use.

blocks.zh: APS 執行順序 (14.0)：五大階段依序為前置確認、範圍定義、計畫開發、模擬執行、文件記錄。Table 14.0-1🔍 提供了全面的檢查清單，涵蓋 18 項前置確認、12 項範圍定義、執行細節和文件要求。
blocks.en: APS performance sequence (14.0): The five phases, in order, are Pre-Initiation, Scope Definition, Plan Development, Execution and Documentation. Table 14.0-1🔍 provides a comprehensive checklist covering 18 pre-initiation items, 12 scope definition items, execution details and documentation requirements.

blocks.zh: 關鍵法規要求：培養雙溫度時每溫至少 7 天（先低溫），陽性單位須鑑定到種並調查根因，介入相關單位的剔除必須與常規生產一致。
blocks.en: Key regulatory requirements: With two-temperature incubation, hold each temperature for at least 7 days (lower temperature first); positive units must be identified to species level and the root cause investigated; rejection of intervention-related units must be consistent with routine production.
